sourceTitle: Potado Masher's Cake With Ricotta Cheese.
sourceText:
Potado Masher's Cake With Ricotta Cheese.
By: Claudia Martinelli
Published: Thursday, February 25, 2010 - 9:54am

Ingredients




You need for the shortcrust pastry:
10 1/2 ounces all purpose flour
5 1/5 ounces sugar
3 1/2 ounces butter
2 eggs
1 bag baking powder for cakes
For the stuffing:
25 ounces ricotta cheese
3 1/2 ounces sugar
Decoration:
inch dark chocolate chopped  irregular pieces
icing sugar

Preparation

1 Mix all the ingredients to make the pastry and divide the loaf in two parts of the same wheight. 2 Put one part in the potato masher, take a baking tin of about 10 inches diameter and press untill strands of pastry fall down. 3 Spread them quite evenly but don't worry if you see holes between the strands: the dough, rising, will close them. 4 Mix ricotta cheese with sugar then pour on the base of pastry's strands, put the other half of the loaf in the potato masher and cover ricotta with the same process, once again don't worry about holes :) 5 Heat the oven at about 345° F, before putting in the oven sprinkle icing sugar on top of the cake and add chocolate chops. 6 Bake for 45 minutes.

About


This recipe is easy peasy, quick and a sure success for any kind of meal, with family, friends, colleagues... 
The cake in the photo misses of the last icing sugar sprinkle but I wanted to take the picture immediately :P
